album.title: Radif Navazi - Setar: Abu Ata, Afshari

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D5 and dwells most on A in Eragh. The line peaks at A4 (444.2 Hz) at 0:15.5. It closes on A3, not the tonic (D4 → E4 → D4 → A2 → A3 → A3).
